messages.subject: Multilevel growth curve model
parts:
Hello everyone
I would like to model the growth of interest in mathematics of students in different classes over three time points. Is it possible to specify a multilevel growth curve model in lavaan?  If so, does anyone know of a tutorial or publication on this?
Thanks a lot! Best wishes, Andrea

messages.author: 5b9c62b1c7cbc1e6
messages.subject: Re: Multilevel growth curve model
parts:
Andrea,

The cluster option should allow this. See https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/multilevel.html and apply it where the level-1 model is your trajectory model applied to wide data.

Pat
